public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        byte[] data = readAll(System.in);
        String input = new String(data, "UTF-8").trim();
        String[] tokens = input.split("\\s+");
        long n = Integer.parseInt(tokens[0]);
        long m = Integer.parseInt(tokens[1]);
        long answer = solve(n, m);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        out.println(answer);
        out.close();
    }

    private static byte[] readAll(InputStream in) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] chunk = new byte[4096];
        int read;
        while ((read = in.read(chunk)) != -1) {
            buffer.write(chunk, 0, read);
        }
        return buffer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static long solve(long n, long m) {
        if (n > m) {
            long t = n;
            n = m;
            m = t;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            long[] subtract = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};

        }
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m == 2) return 0;
            if (m == 3) return 4;
            if (m == 7) return 12;
            return m * 2;
        }
        return (n * m) & ~1L;
    }
}
